memoryBuilder.verseText: Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

sequence.prompt: What happened on the road to Jericho? Put it in order.

items.label: A man is hurt on the road
A priest walks past and ignores him
A temple helper also walks past
The Samaritan stops and helps him

matches.prompt: Match each to what they did.

pairs.right: Walked past on the other side
Stopped, helped, and paid for his care
Said: Go and do the same

application.question: The Samaritan stopped to help someone who needed it. Who around YOU could use help today?
application.followUp: Jesus said: Go and do the same. Your small act of love — stopping, noticing, helping — is exactly what love looks like.
